about.title: Dash Code Success Story
about.subtitle: How a simple idea turned into a complete academic portal serving IT students.
about.why_desc: We all suffered as students from the 'digital chaos' in WhatsApp and Telegram groups, where lectures and files get lost under thousands of messages. We wanted to create one organized, fast, and elegant place that gathers everything an academic student needs.
about.how_desc: The Dash Code team used the latest cloud technologies (Serverless). We relied on Google Drive as file storage, Apps Script as a backend, and Netlify for frontend hosting. This made the site operate at zero cost and lightning speed!
about.team_subtitle: The minds that stayed up late to bring this platform to light

footer.desc_personal: This platform was developed with love to serve our students. If you face any issues or have suggestions to improve the site, don't hesitate to contact us.
